\begin{document}
For a level of width $\Gamma>0$ and real times $t$ and $s$, the retarded propagator $G^R(t,s)$ is
nonzero only for $t>s$. In that region its envelope is a plain exponential,
\begin{equation}
e^{-\Gamma|t-s|/2} = e^{-(t-s)\Gamma/2} .
\label{eq:env}
\end{equation}
